name: Neuroscience PhD (Graduate Programs in Neuroscience)
detailsNote: Official information available; the December 6 deadline is published without a year and is not confirmed for Fall 2027. How students are admitted (program or lab), stipend amounts and whether funding covers international students are not stated on the pages checked.
summary: PhD in neuroscience at Wake Forest University School of Medicine. The first two years combine an interdisciplinary curriculum with hands-on training in research laboratories.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published Neuroscience PhD deadline (Fall)
publishedDeadlines.note: Listed in the School of Medicine deadline table without a year or time, and the page says deadlines are subject to change. Not confirmed for Fall 2027; confirm with the program.

timeline.interviews: Many, but not all, programs require an interview for admission; invitations go out no later than 2 weeks before the interview date. The pages do not give Neuroscience-specific interview dates.

english.note: Minimum recommended scores for international applicants whose native language is not English and who did not attend a US college or university, unless English was the primary medium of instruction.

applicationFee.note: The page says most programs have a $70 fee or a waiver code and that Neuroscience follows this general rule. Waivers are based on financial need, and international students are held to the same criteria as domestic students.

requirements.note: Applications not complete 5 business days after the close date are not reviewed. Official transcripts are required from all schools that granted a degree in order to enroll.

funding.note: PhD applicants are automatically considered for a full tuition scholarship and stipend for living expenses; no amount is stated and no form is required. The page does not say whether this covers international students.
